verdict.rationale: No documentation or evidence addresses item caps or performance behavior specifically at tens-of-thousands-of-issue scale; the feature list is generic marketing copy with no capacity/performance specs. Community comments describe general slowness, bloat, and UI lag (e.g., jira-comm-3, jira-comm-9, jira-comm-10, jira-comm-15), but these are not tied to a documented scale claim, so there is nothing concrete to confirm or dispute regarding caps or large-workspace performance.
